name: semlayer
description: Infers a semantic layer from your data warehouse and serves it to agents over MCP.

layer.title: Semantic layer file
layer.description: A layer you have already built. Leave empty on a first run: the server will report the warehouses it can see and offer to build one.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key
anthropic_api_key.description: Only needed to BUILD a layer, and only for the descriptions. Inference runs without it on statistics alone, and querying an existing layer never needs it.
